sentences.9.4 Har du vært på dugnad?: 9.4 Have you been to a dugnad?
sentences.Biniam er på besøk hos Marek i den nye l: Biniam is visiting Marek in the new apartment.
They are going to watch a football match on TV.
sentences.Så fin den nye leiligheten har blitt. Så: The new apartment looks so nice now. You're so clever. Did you do everything yourselves?
sentences.Ja, jeg er snekker, vet du. Vi har gjort: Yes, I'm a carpenter, you know. We have done a lot in the living room. Do you want to see?
sentences.Her er stua. Før var den mørk og trist,: Here's the living room. It used to be dark and dreary, but now it has become bright and nice, because we painted it white. We bought the sofa second-hand on finn.no. It was very cheap. We can go out onto the balcony from the living room.
sentences.Så fin utsikt dere har fra balkongen!: What a nice view you have from the balcony!
sentences.Ja, og vi har sola til den går ned. Jeg: Yes, and we have the sun until it goes down. I have repaired the old floor here and laid a new floor in the living room.
sentences.Kan jeg se badet og kjøkkenet?: Can I see the bathroom and the kitchen?
sentences.Ja, vær så god, men de rommene er litt g: Yes, go ahead, but those rooms are a bit old and ugly. It is expensive to renovate a bathroom and kitchen. We can't afford it now.
sentences.Har dere spart penger i banken for å kjø: Did you save money in the bank to buy the apartment?
sentences.Ja. Vi har spart penger i mange år, men: Yes. We saved money for many years, but we also had to borrow a little.
sentences.Jeg har vært i banken. Jeg spurte om lån: I have been to the bank. I asked about a loan, but first I need a steady income. I want to move out of the small, dark apartment.
sentences.Du må være tålmodig. Du finner snart en: You have to be patient. You'll find a job soon too.
sentences.Hva er det? Hva betyr dugnad?: What's that? What does dugnad mean?
sentences.Jeg har jobbet ute sammen med naboene. V: I worked outside together with the neighbours. We raked leaves, picked up rubbish and threw away old things.
I have never been to a dugnad.
sentences.Det er gratis arbeid, for vi vil ha det: It is unpaid work, because we want it to be nice around the building. I have got to know a Norwegian neighbour.
You're lucky. I don't know any of my neighbours. The match is starting now!
Yes. I'm looking forward to it.
Marek shows him all the rooms.
sentences.Ewa og Marek har pusset opp stua, men ik: Ewa and Marek have renovated the living room, but not the kitchen and the bathroom, because that is expensive.
sentences.Biniam har spurt om lån i banken, men ha: Biniam has asked about a loan at the bank, but he has to have a permanent job first.
sentences.Marek har vært på dugnad med de nye nabo: Marek has been to a dugnad with the new neighbours today.
sentences.Nå skal Marek og Biniam se på fotballkam: Now Marek and Biniam are going to watch a football match.
A loan to buy a home.
sentences.Jeg ønsker å kjøpe en liten leilighet og: I'd like to buy a small apartment, and I wonder if it is possible to get a loan here at the bank.
sentences.Ja, du er kunde her hos oss, så det skal: Yes, you are a customer of ours, so it should be possible. Do you have a steady income?
No, I haven't got a job yet.
sentences.Da kan du dessverre ikke få lån, men du: Then unfortunately you can't get a loan, but you are welcome to come back when you have a steady income. It is also a good idea to start saving for a home.
sentences.Det er Biniam Tedros. Det gjelder en ann: This is Biniam Tedros. I'm calling about an advert for an apartment to rent. Is it still available?
sentences.Ja, den er ledig. Er du interessert?: Yes, it's available. Are you interested?
sentences.Ja, jeg er veldig interessert. Kan jeg k: Yes, I'm very interested. Can I come and see the apartment?
sentences.Det kan du. Passer det i morgen kveld kl: You can. Does tomorrow evening at half past six suit you?
sentences.Det passer kjempefint. Vi snakkes i morg: That suits me perfectly. Talk to you tomorrow.
I have a loan from the bank.
sentences.Jeg må betale renter og avdrag til banke: I have to pay interest and instalments to the bank every month.
sentences.Det er vanskelig å få lån i banken uten: It is difficult to get a bank loan without a steady income.
